about.title: About Teolingo
about.subtitle: Learn biblical languages interactively
about.platformDesc1: Teolingo is a gamified educational platform designed for the study and learning of the Holy Scriptures in their original languages. We believe that biblical Hebrew and koine Greek should not be dry or unattainable subjects, but rather exciting and motivating paths for any sincere student of the Word of God.
about.platformDesc2: Uniting modern interactive learning methodologies with a deep respect for the sacred text, Teolingo facilitates the assimilation of vocabulary, morphological analysis, and pronunciation to serve as a bridge to a more rigorous and spiritual Bible study.
about.supportDesc: If this resource has been a blessing to your life, ministry, or study of the Scriptures, you can support us to sustain the infrastructure costs that keep Teolingo active, free, and available worldwide.
about.costChat: ChatGPT Plus Subscription (AI models and smart feedback)
about.costTurso: Turso Plan (Distributed SQL Database in the cloud)
about.costResend: Resend Plan (Email delivery and account recovery)
about.costStores: Future store publication (Apple App Store / Google Play)
about.solaScripturaDesc: We accept the Bible as our only rule of faith and practice. We believe that the Holy Scriptures are the written Word of God, inspired by the Holy Spirit and the authoritative revelation of His will.
about.adventistDesc: We hold the 28 fundamental beliefs of the Seventh-day Adventist Church, highlighting salvation by grace through faith in Jesus Christ, the validity of the Ten Commandments (including the Sabbath as biblical rest), and the blessed hope of His soon return.
about.devQuote: "Dedicated to excellence in the study of the Scriptures for the service of the kingdom of God."
about.methodImeDesc: Structured Multisensory Immersion that simultaneously stimulates Visual, Auditory, and Kinesthetic channels.
about.methodColorDesc: Explicit visual grammatical color coding (Root: Grey, Prefixes: Green, Suffixes: Blue, Markers: Orange).
about.methodBloomDesc: Systematic pedagogical progression from basic retention (LOTS) to complex morphological exegetical analysis (HOTS).
about.methodSrsDesc: SuperMemo-2 spaced repetition algorithm adapted to optimize vocabulary memorization and retention.
